body.name: Rmax
body.type: finite dense deterministic response-table enumeration bound
body.def: \(R_{\max}=\max_{\mathsf a}\prod_{j\in W}r_j^{(\prod_{i\in\operatorname{pa}_{\mathsf a}(j)}r_i)(m+3)^{d_{\mathsf a}(j)}}\), where \(\mathsf a\) ranges over the at most \(N!\) saturated ordered superarchitectures, \(\operatorname{pa}_{\mathsf a}(j)\) contains all forward directed slots into \(j\), and \(d_{\mathsf a}(j)\) is the number of formal nonempty child-set sources incident to \(j\)
